I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s API from here, so I can’t pull up the latest scan results for **reddit.com** myself.  

If you’d like to fetch that information yourself, you can use the VirusTotal Public API (or the Enterprise API if you have one). Here’s a quick example of how you could do it with `curl`:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/reddit.com" \
     -H "x-apikey: reddit_api_key"
```

Or, if you prefer Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/reddit.com"
headers = {"x-apikey": "reddit_api_key"}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure you replace `"reddit_api_key"` with your actual API key. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to let me know!
